description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine partiel : Communes concernées par un ou plusieurs captages prioritaires - Périmètres communes (surfacique) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.sigena.fr. This dataset contains the municipalities concerned by one or more priority catchments, in the Aquitaine, Limousin, Poitou-Charentes region. PLEASE NOTE: this dataset is not complete on the perimeter of New Aquitaine, it concerns the former Aquitaine region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Partial New-Aquitaine: Municipalities concerned by one or more priority catchments — Common perimeters (surface)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include captages prioritaires, LIMOUSIN, données ouvertes, limousin, aquitaine, poitou-charentes. The listing shows 2016-01-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
